coverageGaps: Entry-only observers do not capture return values, float-register argument values, IFix path selection, server acceptance or asynchronous ownership.

Maps/repeated collections are not traversed: initial mission/dialog dictionaries, incoming mission objective numeric values/extraDetails, dialog option/finish wire lists, and the full LevelScript conditionCompletedMap remain unsampled.

Typed task tracking retains the supplied objectiveIndex/completionBool. Its current reviewed caller supplies objectiveEnum; preparation does not prove that control flow on another build. No unique conditionId or unchanged incoming map member is retained.

Global condition polling getters and result/progress setters are omitted to avoid unproved volume. GameCondition.set_progress also lacks a bounded current .pdata body; condition lifecycle snapshots do not replace per-change numeric progress events.
A stored parentQuestId is explicit receiver context; null values remain a coverage gap and timestamp proximity never supplies missing ownership.

Base-typed condition storage and observed declared method families do not authenticate the receiver's actual runtime subtype. Named numeric progress requests do not replace incoming objective-map delivery or a successful send/acknowledgment.

Snapshot notification retains a supplied identifyGroupId; snapshot-condition GetResult retains its supplied event payload with stored quest/condition context. Bound Param<string>, comparison/result and authoritative success remain unread; temporal proximity never supplies missing ownership. Interactive request/property entries retain explicit carriers, not successful writes or incoming map contents.
